easyPrerequisites: Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Altanak.
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, causing target opponent to gain control of Altanak.
Activate the ability granted to Altanak by Martyrdom an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
